title: [Pt] Premarket Breakout Strategy
author: PtGambler

source_facts.fact: Strategy described for SPY or QQQ.
Premarket high and low defined over 09:00–09:30 EST as written; daylight-saving behavior not verified.
First breakout above premarket high supplies prospective long direction.
First breakout below premarket low supplies prospective short direction.
For long, waits until Stochastic RSI D reaches lower threshold (default 18), then enters on K crossing above D.
For short, waits until Stochastic RSI D reaches upper threshold (default 82), then enters on K crossing below D.
Long stop described using premarket low or range plus ATR percentage buffer, conditional on entry location; exact Pine formula not verified.
Short stop described using premarket high or range plus ATR percentage buffer, conditional on entry location; exact Pine formula not verified.
Different Stochastic RSI lengths suggested for 5-minute timeframe; actual values not supplied in page text.

evidence_boundaries: Description is not the Pine source; thresholds and rules must be verified against executable code.
The author describes historical profitability without independently verified market backtest.
